<MethodEndpoint
  method={"delete"}
  path={"/api/v1.0/audits/policies/{AssetAuditPolicyId}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Deletes an asset audit policy and removes all associated schedules and configurations. This operation permanently removes the policy from the system. Any scheduled audits that were generated by this policy will be deleted, and the policy will no longer generate new audit schedules. This action cannot be undone.

**Prerequisites:**
- Asset Audit Policy ID must be obtained from [GET /api/v1.0/audits/policies](/docs/api/audits/get-asset-audit-policies)

**Workflow Example:**
1. List all policies: [GET /api/v1.0/audits/policies](/docs/api/audits/get-asset-audit-policies)
2. Extract the target policy's `AssetAuditPolicyId` from `Items[].AssetAuditPolicyId`
3. Optionally verify the policy details: [GET /api/v1.0/audits/policies/\{AssetAuditPolicyId\}](/docs/api/audits/get-asset-audit-policy)
4. Delete the policy using this endpoint

**Response:**
Returns a confirmation message that the policy was successfully deleted.
